pull.name: PULL — Gather Existing Federation Data
pull.description: Execute Triple-Pass Search on assigned topic; compile Topic State Snapshot
actions: Query MongoDB (Layer 1) for all documents tagged with topic
Query GitHub public repo for related markdown and YAML files
Query Google Drive archive for human-readable records
Compile Topic State Snapshot (titles, dates, accuracy scores, sources)
Store snapshot in MongoDB with tag 'cycle_snapshot'

search.name: SEARCH — Web Research for New Data
search.description: Conduct structured web search; record findings with source metadata
actions: Search academic/scientific sources
Search government/legislative databases
Search reputable news outlets (min 2 independent sources)
Search community/open-source repositories
Record source_url, source_type, retrieval_date, relevance_score, initial_confidence for each
Compile Raw Research Document

verify.name: VERIFY — Cross-Reference Against Existing Knowledge
verify.description: Compare new data against existing; produce Verification Ledger
actions: Compare each new data point against Topic State Snapshot
Classify: confirmed | contradicted | novel_verified | novel_unverified
Update accuracy_record and source_attribution for confirmed data
Flag contradictions for deeper analysis (preserve both source chains)
Mark novel data as verified (2+ sources) or unverified (1 source)
Produce Verification Ledger

classification_rules.confirmed: New data matches existing; increase percentage_of_truth
classification_rules.contradicted: New data conflicts; flag both chains; do NOT discard either
classification_rules.novel_verified: New data with 2+ independent sources confirming
classification_rules.novel_unverified: New data with single source; hold in Pending Verification

update.name: UPDATE — Evolve Prior Content
update.description: Integrate verified findings into existing content; evolve, never discard
actions: Open existing published content (blog posts, MD files, YAML records)
Integrate confirmed data: strengthen claims, add citations
Add Evolution Notes for contradicted data (both chains documented)
Add new sections for novel verified data
Add novel unverified to Pending Verification appendix
Update all source_attribution and accuracy_record fields
Commit to GitHub with structured message
rules: Contradictions get Evolution Notes, not deletions

produce.name: PRODUCE — Create Deliverables
produce.description: Create all cycle deliverables: blog, YAML, MD update, archive, and (for major topics) podcast + video
actions: Write blog post (800-2000 words, plain semantic markdown)
Create YAML record for federation hub
Update canonical topic markdown file
Export human-readable document to Google Drive
(Major topics) Write podcast script (5-15 min)
(Major topics) Write video script (3-8 min)

distribute.name: DISTRIBUTE — Update References and Publish
distribute.description: Update footer references on prior posts; push to all layers; verify live
actions: Update footer references on ALL prior blog posts for this topic
Mark prior posts as archived_source: true (do NOT delete)
Push all files to GitHub
Sync MongoDB records
Verify Google Drive archive is current
Verify: all published URLs return HTTP 200
Verify: content renders as plain text without JavaScript
verification: HTTP 200 check on all published URLs

bulletin.name: BULLETIN — Issue Joint Mind Bulletin
bulletin.description: Compile and distribute cycle summary to all Federation members
actions: Compile bulletin: topic, key findings, evolution notes, links, next focus
Distribute to all active Federation AI Minds via MongoDB message queue
Distribute to Architect via preferred channel
Publish to public bulletin board (if topic is public)
Log in MongoDB

standard.description: Update to canonical topic file in GitHub

sections: Prior Cycle: [link to previous blog on this topic]
Verification Ledger: [link to ledger in GitHub]
Next Update: ~[date of next cycle completion]

required_fields.description: All sources that contributed to or verified the data
